categories.title: Massages
categories.subtitle: Signature techniques from around the world

items.name: Traditional Balinese
items.desc: Balinese massage is a good therapy to choose if you want to experience a variety of techniques to relax the body and boost your circulation. The massage technique borrows the best bits from different therapies. The main goal of Balinese massage is to achieve a relaxed state of mind by easing the flow of blood through the body. This is a deep massage technique that works on all the muscles of the body.

items.name: Signature of Serenity
items.desc: During the aromatherapy and massage session at Serenity Spa, you will plunge into an atmosphere of harmony and peace. Soft light, pleasant music and fragrant oils create the perfect environment for relaxation and recovery. You will feel the tension leaving your body and the mind calming down.

items.name: Hawaiian Ka Huna
items.desc: This is a unique, flowing, energetically vibrant yet deeply relaxing whole-body massage. Flowing long strokes are what characterize this special method of body work, along with a range of stretches. The second dimension is for the therapist to get in touch with your breathing, enabling a special connection and becoming one.

items.name: Hawaiian Ka Huna
items.desc: This is a unique, flowing, energetically vibrant yet deeply relaxing whole-body massage. Flowing long strokes are what characterize this special method of body work, along with a range of stretches. The second dimension is for the therapist to get in touch with your breathing, enabling a special connection and becoming one.

items.name: Detox (Lymphatic Drainage)
items.desc: Lymphatic drainage massage is a therapy designed to improve the functioning of the lymphatic system. This is achieved primarily through soft, rhythmic circular movements of the skin, which stimulate the contraction of lymphatic vessels and reduce toxins in the body. Lymphatic drainage massage helps improve metabolism and reduce swelling.

items.name: Body Breath
items.desc: Deep muscle therapeutic massage designed to release tension and stress. This massage technique and its manipulations help alleviate soreness while enhancing range of motion with firm to deep pressure.

items.name: Back, Neck & Shoulders
items.desc: Back, neck and shoulder massage can offer a number of health benefits. It can encourage relaxation, relieve stress, improve circulation and relax muscles. This treatment is especially good for relieving tension headaches, improving flexibility and can help strengthen the immune system.

items.name: Foot Reflexology
items.desc: Stimulating reflex points on the feet increases blood and oxygen circulation throughout the body, instilling deep relaxation.

items.name: Head & Neck Massage
items.desc: Pleasant aroma and soft touch create an atmosphere of harmony and tranquility, allowing you to completely relax and enjoy the process. Head and neck massage is a luxurious treatment that brings a feeling of complete relaxation and bliss.

items.name: Hot Stone Therapy
items.desc: Are you often sleep-deprived or exhausted? Hot stone therapy could be the solution. It is one of the best treatments to release muscle tension and soreness, as the heat from the stones enhances the effect of massage. As the stones used in this therapy can retain heat for a longer time, it helps the person relax and re-energize.

items.name: Herbal SPA Massage
items.desc: Herbal SPA massage derives from an age-old Siamese healing tradition. A bouquet of fine, select herbs wrapped in a linen cloth glides softly over the skin. You can feel the warmth and vigor of Siam's natural vitality spreading over your skin. Tender care as if from an herbal paradise promotes circulation, releases muscular tension, gives your skin a feeling of extraordinary well-being and pampers the spirit.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: Serenity Spa Privacy Policy: what data we collect, how we use and protect our clients' personal information.

sections.title: 1. What data we collect
sections.content: Name, phone number, selected service, preferred booking date, request comment, as well as technical visit data (referral source, UTM tags, device type, browser, IP address) for analytics and request processing.

sections.title: 2. Processing purposes
sections.content: Data is used to contact the client, confirm and support bookings, improve service quality, evaluate advertising channel effectiveness and protect against abuse.

sections.title: 3. Data protection
sections.content: We take technical and organizational measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, modification, disclosure or destruction.

sections.title: 4. Contacts
sections.content: For data processing inquiries, please call +998 71 210 88 95 or email info@serenity-spa.uz.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.metaDescription: Serenity Spa Terms of Service: website usage conditions, booking procedures and service interaction.

sections.title: 1. Website purpose
sections.content: The website provides information about services, programs and contact details of Serenity Spa. Submitting a booking form means a request for callback and visit confirmation.

sections.title: 2. Booking services
sections.content: Booking date and time are considered confirmed only after contact with the administrator. Serenity Spa reserves the right to clarify request details and offer the nearest available slots.

sections.title: 3. Limitation of liability
sections.content: Information on the website is provided on an 'as is' basis. Serenity Spa makes efforts to keep it current but does not guarantee the absolute absence of inaccuracies.

sections.title: 4. Contacts
sections.content: For website and booking inquiries, please call +998 71 210 88 95 or email info@serenity-spa.uz.
